calendar.title: Business calendar and holidays
calendar.intro: Business days and hours set the due time of approval tasks. A change counts for tasks assigned after you save; tasks already assigned keep their due time.
calendar.timeHint: Thai time ({timezone}), counted straight through without a lunch break
calendar.saved: Business hours saved. Tasks assigned from now on use the new hours; tasks already assigned keep their due time.
calendar.holidaysEmpty: No holidays for this year or later yet. Import the year's holidays from an Excel file under Import holidays.
calendar.importIntro: Download the template, fill one holiday per row from row 3, then check the file. You see the holidays it would add and confirm them before anything is saved. If any row is wrong, the rows to fix are listed and nothing is saved. Dates already in the calendar are skipped.
calendar.checkAdd: {count, plural, one {# holiday to add} other {# holidays to add}}
calendar.checkSkip: {count, plural, one {# date is} other {# dates are}} already in the calendar and will be skipped (their names stay)
calendar.confirm: Confirm adding {count, plural, one {this holiday} other {these # holidays}}: once added, a holiday cannot be removed or renamed, and it counts for the due time of approval tasks assigned from now on
calendar.imported: {added, plural, one {# holiday added} other {# holidays added}}
calendar.importedSkipped: {added, plural, one {# holiday added} other {# holidays added}}; {skipped, plural, one {# date already in the calendar was} other {# dates already in the calendar were}} skipped (their names stay)
calendar.importedNothing: No new holidays: {skipped, plural, one {the date of the file is} other {all # dates of the file are}} already in the calendar
calendar.importErrors: Nothing was saved. Fix these rows and check the file again.

importReasons.INVALID_DATE: Not a valid date; use 2027-04-13 or 13/04/2570
importReasons.DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Only dates in the years {from} to {to} (Buddhist era) can be imported; check the year
importReasons.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: The same date is on another row of the file
importReasons.NO_ROWS: The file has no data from row 3
importReasons.TOO_MANY_ROWS: More than 500 rows; split the file and import the parts one by one
importReasons.UNREADABLE: The file cannot be read; use the template from the download link
importReasons.MISSING_HEADER: Row 1 must hold the column codes of the template. Do not change it; download a new template and copy your data into it

template.line1: Fill one holiday per row from row 3. Do not change row 1 (column codes).
template.line2: Write dates as year-month-day in the Christian era (2027-04-13) or day/month/year in the Buddhist era (13/04/2570).
template.line3: Dates already in the calendar are skipped; their names stay.
template.line4: New holidays count for approval tasks assigned after the import; tasks already assigned keep their due time.

errors.END_BEFORE_START: The end time must be after the start time
errors.FILE_MISSING: Choose the filled Excel file before checking it
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 900 KB; split it and import the parts one by one
errors.CONFIRM: Tick the confirmation box before adding the holidays
errors.RECHECK: Something changed since the check; check the file again before adding the holidays

numbering.title: Document number patterns
numbering.intro: A document gets its number when it is submitted. You can change a pattern at any time: numbers already issued never change and are never issued again. If the current number series still applies, numbering goes on; a new series starts at 1.
numbering.nextNone: The saved pattern cannot issue a number yet; fix it and save
numbering.patternHint: Use the codes from the list of codes, e.g. {example}
numbering.previewTitle: If you save, the next number will be
numbering.previewContinues: Goes on from the numbers already issued in this series
numbering.previewNew: A new number series starting at 1
numbering.previewUnavailable: No example yet; reload the page and try again
numbering.previewRefused: This pattern cannot be saved yet; fix it as the message under Number pattern says
numbering.tokensTitle: Codes you can use in a pattern

tokens.YY: Last 2 digits of the Buddhist-era year, e.g. 69
tokens.DEPT: Code of the department charged, e.g. CON
tokens.SEQ: Running number padded with zeros to its width, e.g. {example} = 00001; it grows wider by itself

numbering.tokensNote: All values are Thai time when the number is issued. Counting again every year needs the year in the number; every month needs both year and month.

refusals.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: Unknown code {tokens}; use the codes from the list
refusals.SEQ_MISSING: The pattern needs one running number, e.g. {example}
refusals.SEQ_REPEATED: The pattern may have only one running number; remove the extra one
refusals.SEQ_WIDTH: The running number needs at least 1 digit, e.g. {example}
refusals.YEAR_MISSING: Counting again every year or month needs the year in the number, otherwise next year repeats this year's numbers. Add a year code, or choose never
refusals.MONTH_MISSING: Counting again every month needs the month in the number, otherwise next month repeats this month's numbers. Add the month code, or count again every year
refusals.NUMBER_COLLISION: This pattern would issue {example}, which was issued already. Make it differ from the earlier numbers, e.g. add the month or change the prefix
refusals.OVERLAPS_OTHER_DOCUMENT: This pattern can issue the same numbers as {other}, e.g. {example}. Use a different prefix

requestTypes.title: Request types
requestTypes.intro: This list is the order requesters see on the new request page. Types switched off are not shown to requesters; requests already made do not change.
requestTypes.empty: No request types yet. The first types come from the RequestTypes sheet of the starting data; contact the BCS team.
requestTypes.switchedOff: {name} is off. Requesters no longer see it on the new request page; requests already made do not change.
requestTypes.switchedOn: {name} is on. Requesters see it on the new request page.

errors.AT_EDGE: This type is already at that end of the list
errors.NO_PUBLISHED_FORM: This type has no form yet; import a form first, then switch it on
errors.NO_CHANGE: The type is already so; reload the page to see its latest state
